tool_args.rationale: The nonlinear pilot response and conservation signature are consistent with a bridge mechanism, but the supplied rows vary only u_now. A discriminating probe is needed before fitting and confirming a quantitative law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary snapshot or two-layer siphon model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations hold the other inputs and horizon fixed, so their effects and the bridge dynamics are not identifiable.
The cheaper branch-discriminating probe is more directly suited to resolving the mechanism ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the bridge mechanism.
